Converplast Embalagens Ltda.evidence: Brazilian business registry and industry associations confirm that Converplast Embalagens Ltda is an active company based in Guarulhos, operating the website converplast.com.br. According to the Brazilian Packaging Association (ABRE), the company manufactures flexible packaging and plastic films serving the health and pharmaceutical sectors.

Danapak Flexibles A/S.event: Renamed to adapa flexibles Denmark Slagelse A/S as part of the adapa Group rebranding
Danapak Flexibles A/S.evidence: According to the company's official website, the entity formerly known as Danapak Flexibles A/S operates as the Pharma Centre of Excellence under the name adapa flexibles Denmark Slagelse A/S, supplying high-quality laminates and films for the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

Mega Embalagens Ltda..event: partnered/renamed to Mega Goglio Latam SA
Mega Embalagens Ltda..evidence: The company's website lists its address in Salvador do Sul, Brazil, and explicitly features a 'Médico Hospitalar' (Medical Hospital) packaging product line. The site notes that it recently entered a new phase partnered with the Italian group Goglio, operating under the copyright name Mega Goglio Latam SA in 2026.

Mitsui Chemicals Tohcello, Inc..evidence: Mitsui Chemicals announced that effective April 1, 2024, Mitsui Chemicals Tohcello, Inc. split its ICT business into Mitsui Chemicals ICT Materia, Inc., and its packaging solution business absorbed SunTox Co., Ltd. to become RM Tohcello Co., Ltd. according to official company press releases.

Sealed Air Corporation.evidence: The company's official website confirms it is active and manufactures medical-grade polymer films, including NEXCEL primary medical films and parenteral packaging materials. Industry publications further establish its active presence as a medical packaging film supplier.

Texol S.r.l..evidence: According to the company's official website and industry trade news, Texol S.r.l. is an active Italian manufacturer based in Alanno that produces innovative perforated plastic films and elastic laminates for the medical and hygiene sectors, including protective garments like disposable drapes and gowns.
